title: Daily Condensed Matter Literature
note: 2026-10-22 archival issue, assembled from the first Journal Club plus follow-up selections.

papers.title: Nontrivial Boundary-Mediated Superconducting Transport in a TRSB Topological Iron-Based Superconductor
papers.authors: Wenyao Liu, Gabriel Natale, Camron Farhang et al.
papers.summary: 在 FeTe₀.₅₅Se₀.₄₅ 薄片中结合 Kerr 与局域/非局域输运，报告和 TRSB 温标相关的边缘超导电导 plateau。
papers.method: Polar Kerr; edge-contact differential conductance; nonlocal transport; sample and contact geometry comparisons.
papers.result: 报告连续边缘上的异常 conductance plateau，温度演化与 Kerr 定义的 TRSB 温标相关。
papers.future: 适用于对 4Hb-TaS₂ 等候选材料设计不同接触几何的非局域输运实验。
papers.summary_zh: 在 FeTe₀.₅₅Se₀.₄₅ 薄片中结合 Kerr 与局域/非局域输运，报告和 TRSB 温标相关的边缘超导电导 plateau。
papers.summary_en: Using polar Kerr rotation and local/nonlocal transport in FeTe₀.₅₅Se₀.₄₅ flakes, the authors report an edge-associated conductance plateau whose temperature dependence tracks the onset of time-reversal symmetry breaking.
papers.method_zh: Polar Kerr; edge-contact differential conductance; nonlocal transport; sample and contact geometry comparisons.
papers.method_en: Polar Kerr measurements, edge-contact differential conductance, nonlocal transport, and comparison of contact geometries.
papers.result_zh: 报告连续边缘上的异常 conductance plateau，温度演化与 Kerr 定义的 TRSB 温标相关。
papers.result_en: An anomalous conductance plateau is observed along a continuous edge; its temperature evolution correlates with the Kerr-defined TRSB onset.
papers.future_zh: 适用于对 4Hb-TaS₂ 等候选材料设计不同接触几何的非局域输运实验。
papers.future_en: Test edge-contact geometries and nonlocal superconducting transport in 4Hb-TaS₂ or other candidate TRSB superconductors.

papers.title: Hybridization-Induced Enhancement of the Thermoelectric Response in the Kagome Material CsCr₆Sb₆
papers.authors: Hongye Zhang, Boqin Song, Aifeng Wang et al.
papers.corresponding: Ying Zhu; Tianping Ying; Mingquan He
papers.summary: 测量 CsCr₆Sb₆ 单晶的 Seebeck、Nernst、Hall、比热与热导，关联热电增强与能带杂化、Kondo scattering 和 phonon drag。
papers.method: Flux-grown single crystals; resistivity, Hall, Seebeck, Nernst, thermal conductivity, specific heat.
papers.result: 作者识别 ~70 K 的 crossover 和 ~20–25 K 热电极值，并讨论重费米子标度及声子贡献。
papers.future: 同样品测 Sxx、Syx、Hall、ρxx，加入角分辨和应变调控。
papers.summary_zh: 测量 CsCr₆Sb₆ 单晶的 Seebeck、Nernst、Hall、比热与热导，关联热电增强与能带杂化、Kondo scattering 和 phonon drag。
papers.summary_en: Measurements of Seebeck and Nernst signals, Hall response, thermal conductivity, and heat capacity in CsCr₆Sb₆ link enhanced thermoelectric transport with band hybridization, Kondo scattering, and phonon drag.
papers.method_zh: Flux-grown single crystals; resistivity, Hall, Seebeck, Nernst, thermal conductivity, specific heat.
papers.method_en: Flux-grown single crystals; electrical resistivity, Hall, Seebeck, Nernst, thermal conductivity, and heat-capacity measurements.
papers.result_zh: 作者识别 ~70 K 的 crossover 和 ~20–25 K 热电极值，并讨论重费米子标度及声子贡献。
papers.result_en: The authors identify a crossover near 70 K and thermoelectric extrema around 20–25 K, and discuss heavy-fermion scaling and phonon contributions.
papers.future_zh: 同样品测 Sxx、Syx、Hall、ρxx，加入角分辨和应变调控。
papers.future_en: Measure longitudinal and transverse thermopower, Hall response, and resistivity on the same crystal, with angle-resolved and strain-dependent follow-ups.
papers.tier_reason_en: Detailed thermoelectric, Nernst, Hall, and thermal-transport characterization connects band hybridization to a correlated kagome metal; the central advance is a material-specific transport interpretation rather than a new universal effect.
papers.tier_reason_zh: 系统的 Seebeck、Nernst、Hall 与热输运实验把能带杂化和 Kagome 关联行为联系起来；亮点是材料体系中的输运物理，而非全新的普适效应。

papers.title: Magnetization and Josephson current coupling drives the Josephson diode effect in FeTe₀.₅₅Se₀.₄₅ van der Waals junctions
papers.authors: Seung-Hyun Shin, Cheong-Eung Ahn, Chang-Won Choi et al.
papers.summary: 在 FeTeSe 范德华约瑟夫森结中发现零场二极管效应，结合 Fraunhofer、Shapiro steps 与动力学建模研究磁化与超流耦合。
papers.method: van der Waals Josephson junction fabrication; switching currents; Fraunhofer pattern; microwave Shapiro steps.
papers.result: 非互易临界电流与界面磁化和 Josephson 相位耦合相关。
papers.future: 在可加工材料中比较 Ic+ / Ic−、场历史、Fraunhofer 和微波响应。
papers.summary_zh: 在 FeTeSe 范德华约瑟夫森结中发现零场二极管效应，结合 Fraunhofer、Shapiro steps 与动力学建模研究磁化与超流耦合。
papers.summary_en: In FeTe₀.₅₅Se₀.₄₅ van der Waals Josephson junctions, the authors report a zero-field Josephson diode effect and examine the coupling of interfacial magnetization to the supercurrent.
papers.method_zh: van der Waals Josephson junction fabrication; switching currents; Fraunhofer pattern; microwave Shapiro steps.
papers.method_en: Fabrication of van der Waals Josephson junctions; switching-current, Fraunhofer-interference, and microwave Shapiro-step measurements.
papers.result_zh: 非互易临界电流与界面磁化和 Josephson 相位耦合相关。
papers.result_en: Nonreciprocal critical current is attributed to the coupling between interfacial magnetization and the Josephson phase.
papers.future_zh: 在可加工材料中比较 Ic+ / Ic−、场历史、Fraunhofer 和微波响应。
papers.future_en: Compare positive and negative critical currents, magnetic-field training, Fraunhofer patterns, and microwave response in device-compatible superconductors.
papers.tier_reason_en: Combines zero-field Josephson diode behavior, hysteretic Fraunhofer interference, half-integer Shapiro steps, and coupled dynamical modeling to identify a specific interfacial mechanism.
papers.tier_reason_zh: 结合零场 Josephson diode、磁滞 Fraunhofer、半整数 Shapiro 台阶及动力学模拟，建立界面磁化与 Josephson 电流耦合的机制。

papers.title: Altermagnetism in Folded Iron Chain Systems
papers.authors: Ling-Fang Lin, Yang Zhang, Satoshi Okamoto et al.
papers.summary: 理论研究折叠铁链的 block-type order 与链间跃迁，提出动量依赖自旋劈裂及潜在 altermagnet 候选材料。
papers.result: 在 quasi-1D 阵列中得到 altermagnetic spin splitting 的理论条件。
papers.future: 评估 K₃Fe₂Se₄ 生长路线和角分辨磁性输运。
papers.summary_zh: 理论研究折叠铁链的 block-type order 与链间跃迁，提出动量依赖自旋劈裂及潜在 altermagnet 候选材料。
papers.summary_en: A theoretical study of folded iron-chain systems identifies symmetry conditions for momentum-dependent spin splitting associated with altermagnetic order.
papers.method_en: Magnetic-symmetry analysis and first-principles electronic-structure calculations.
papers.result_zh: 在 quasi-1D 阵列中得到 altermagnetic spin splitting 的理论条件。
papers.result_en: The authors identify theoretical conditions for altermagnetic spin splitting in quasi-one-dimensional folded-chain arrays.
papers.future_zh: 评估 K₃Fe₂Se₄ 生长路线和角分辨磁性输运。
papers.future_en: Explore synthesis of K₃Fe₂Se₄ candidates and characterize field-angle-dependent magnetic transport.

papers.title: Magnon Chern Insulator in Two-Dimensional Fully Compensated Ferrimagnetic Heterostructures
papers.authors: Yingxi Bai, Zhiqi Chen, Baibiao Huang et al.
papers.summary: 提出完全补偿二维 ferrimagnetic heterostructure 中的 magnon Chern bands 与 magnon thermal Hall response。
papers.result: 预测 CrI₃/CrGeTe₃ 等异质结的拓扑磁振子和热 Hall 响应。
papers.future: 结合薄层异质结制备开展热 Hall 测量。
papers.summary_zh: 提出完全补偿二维 ferrimagnetic heterostructure 中的 magnon Chern bands 与 magnon thermal Hall response。
papers.summary_en: A theoretical proposal predicts magnon Chern bands and a magnon thermal Hall response in fully compensated two-dimensional ferrimagnetic heterostructures.
papers.result_zh: 预测 CrI₃/CrGeTe₃ 等异质结的拓扑磁振子和热 Hall 响应。
papers.result_en: Topological magnons and thermal Hall signatures are predicted for heterostructures including CrI₃/CrGeTe₃.
papers.future_zh: 结合薄层异质结制备开展热 Hall 测量。
papers.future_en: Investigate thermal Hall measurements in fabricated layered magnetic heterostructures.

papers.title: Large anisotropic magnetoresistance in paramagnetic Fe-doped Ta₄SiTe₄
papers.authors: Keita Nagasawa, Ryutaro Okuma, Jun-ichi Yamaura et al.
papers.summary: 研究 Fe 掺杂准一维 Ta₄SiTe₄ 在顺磁态下的大幅 AMR，并用各向异性 spin-disorder scattering 描述。
papers.result: 在 8 K、10 T 条件下报告约 −33% AMR。
papers.future: 同步测量 M(B,θ)、torque 和 MR(B,θ)。
papers.summary_zh: 研究 Fe 掺杂准一维 Ta₄SiTe₄ 在顺磁态下的大幅 AMR，并用各向异性 spin-disorder scattering 描述。
papers.summary_en: The authors report unusually large anisotropic magnetoresistance in the paramagnetic regime of Fe-doped quasi-one-dimensional Ta₄SiTe₄ and discuss anisotropic spin-disorder scattering.
papers.result_zh: 在 8 K、10 T 条件下报告约 −33% AMR。
papers.result_en: An anisotropic magnetoresistance of approximately −33% is reported at 8 K and 10 T.
papers.future_zh: 同步测量 M(B,θ)、torque 和 MR(B,θ)。
papers.future_en: Combine angle-dependent magnetization, torque, and magnetoresistance on the same crystal.
papers.tier_reason_en: Substantial paramagnetic AMR is demonstrated with magnetization anisotropy and a spin-disorder description in one well-characterized material system.
papers.tier_reason_zh: 在单一材料体系中展示了较大的顺磁态 AMR，并用磁化各向异性和 spin-disorder 模型进行解释，属于扎实的材料输运研究。

papers.title: Spin order and excitations in the collinear kagome antiferromagnet Y₀.₅Fe₃Sn₃
papers.summary: 利用中子散射研究 kagome 反铁磁体 Y₀.₅Fe₃Sn₃ 的磁结构和激发，并结合磁场诱导 canting 讨论 AHE。
papers.method: Elastic, inelastic, and polarized neutron scattering.
papers.result: 报告高温共线 AFM 有序、Y-shaped spin excitations 和双能隙特征。
papers.future: 单晶磁输运与 torque 测量可补充磁各向异性信息。
papers.summary_zh: 利用中子散射研究 kagome 反铁磁体 Y₀.₅Fe₃Sn₃ 的磁结构和激发，并结合磁场诱导 canting 讨论 AHE。
papers.summary_en: Neutron-scattering experiments resolve the magnetic structure and spin excitations of the kagome antiferromagnet Y₀.₅Fe₃Sn₃, with field-induced spin canting discussed in relation to anomalous Hall transport.
papers.method_zh: Elastic, inelastic, and polarized neutron scattering.
papers.method_en: Elastic, inelastic, and polarized neutron scattering.
papers.result_zh: 报告高温共线 AFM 有序、Y-shaped spin excitations 和双能隙特征。
papers.result_en: The authors report high-temperature collinear antiferromagnetic order, Y-shaped spin excitations, and two spin-gap scales.
papers.future_zh: 单晶磁输运与 torque 测量可补充磁各向异性信息。
papers.future_en: Use angle-dependent magnetic transport and torque magnetometry to map anisotropy and field-induced magnetic responses in single crystals.

papers.title: Valence-Driven Structural Transformation and Phase Coexistence in Chemically Substituted EuPd₂Si₂
papers.summary: 通过化学替代和同步辐射衍射研究 EuPd₂Si₂ 价态转变与结构相共存。
papers.result: 报道 Ge 替代对价态转变温度和结构相共存的影响。
papers.future: 适用于联合热容、电阻、磁化与应变响应追踪价态相变。
papers.summary_zh: 通过化学替代和同步辐射衍射研究 EuPd₂Si₂ 价态转变与结构相共存。
papers.summary_en: Through chemical substitution and synchrotron diffraction, the authors investigate the coupling of valence changes to structural transformation and phase coexistence in EuPd₂Si₂.
papers.method_en: Controlled chemical substitution and synchrotron X-ray diffraction.
papers.result_zh: 报道 Ge 替代对价态转变温度和结构相共存的影响。
papers.result_en: Ge substitution changes the valence-transition temperature and the coexistence of structural phases.
papers.future_zh: 适用于联合热容、电阻、磁化与应变响应追踪价态相变。
papers.future_en: Combine heat capacity, resistivity, magnetization, and strain measurements to track valence-driven transitions.
